+class _Side:
+    """One branch of a snowflake join graph rooted at the fact table: a neighbour
+    of the fact table together with every relation reachable from it without
+    passing through the fact table.
+
+    Every join on the way out of the fact table is many-to-one, so the branch's
+    features are a function of the fact table's join key with the neighbour.
+    They are denormalised into one small side table holding one row per key
+    value present in the fact table (never a fact-scale relation)."""
+
+    def __init__(self, neighbour, keys, neighbour_keys, relations):
+        self.neighbour = neighbour
+        # join columns of the fact table; also the key columns of the side table
+        self.keys = keys
+        self.neighbour_keys = neighbour_keys
+        # relations of the branch, in DFS order from the neighbour
+        self.relations = relations
+        # (relation, feature) -> column of the side table
+        self.columns = {}
+        self.table = None
+
+    def column(self, relation, attr):
+        return self.columns[(relation, value_to_sql(attr, qualified=False))]
+
+    def predicate(self, relation, annotation):
+        """SQL of an annotation of `relation`, evaluated over the side table."""
+        if annotation.selection in (SELECTION.NULL, SELECTION.NOT_NULL):
+            para = self.column(relation, annotation.para)
+        else:
+            para = (self.column(relation, annotation.para[0]),) + tuple(annotation.para[1:])
+        return "(" + selection_to_sql(SelectionExpression(annotation.selection, para), qualified=False) + ")"
+
+    def on(self, left, right):
+        return " AND ".join(f"{left}.{k} = {right}.{k}" for k in self.keys)
+
+    def key_list(self, alias):
+        return ", ".join(f"{alias}.{k}" for k in self.keys)

+class _Factorised:
+    """Fit-wide state of the factorised training representation.
+
+    The residuals live in one slim fact table (gradient column plus the fact
+    table's join keys). A node's message towards a branch holds its residual sums
+    per branch key next to the branch's features, so every split statistic is a
+    small aggregation over it. A split on a branch only filters the messages
+    towards that branch; one aggregation over the fact table gives the smaller
+    child's messages towards the other branches, and the sibling's follow by
+    subtraction from the parent's."""

+    def __init__(self, cjt):

+        self.g_col, self.h_col = cjt.semi_ring.get_columns_name()
+        self.sides = []
+        self.side_of = {}
+        for neighbour in cjt.joins[self.fact]:
+            keys, neighbour_keys = cjt.joins[self.fact][neighbour]["keys"]
+            relations = []
+
+            def dfs(relation, parent):
+                relations.append(relation)
+                for child in cjt.joins[relation]:
+                    if child != parent:
+                        dfs(child, relation)
+
+            dfs(neighbour, self.fact)
+            side = _Side(neighbour, list(keys), list(neighbour_keys), relations)
+            for relation in relations:

+                for attr in cjt.relations[relation]:

+    @staticmethod

+        annotation = small.annotations[self.features[feature].table()][-1]
+        if annotation.selection == SELECTION.NOT_GREATER:
+            hi = split_bin
+        else:
+            lo = split_bin + 1
+        members = self.table(
+            f"SELECT m.* FROM {parent.marginals[branch]} m JOIN {self.bin_maps[branch]} b "
+            f"USING(k) WHERE bin BETWEEN {lo} AND {hi}"
+        )
+        small.marginals = {branch: members}
+        large.marginals = {branch: self.table(
+            f"SELECT m.* FROM {parent.marginals[branch]} m ANTI JOIN {members} USING(k)"
+        )}
+        small.restricted = large.restricted = parent.restricted | {branch}
+        fact = self.root.target_relation
+        g_col, h_col = self.root.semi_ring.get_columns_name()
+        for b, mapping in self.bin_maps.items():
+            if b == branch:
+                continue
+            joins = [f"JOIN {members} x ON x.k=t.{self.keys[branch]}"]
+            for i, restricted in enumerate(parent.restricted - {b, branch}):
+                joins.append(f"JOIN {parent.marginals[restricted]} r{i} ON r{i}.k=t.{self.keys[restricted]}")
+            key = self.keys[b]
+            agg = (
+                f"SELECT t.{key} AS k,sum(t.{g_col}) AS s,sum(t.{h_col})::BIGINT AS n "
+                f"FROM {fact} t {' '.join(joins)} GROUP BY t.{key}"
+            )
+            total = parent.marginals[b]
+            if b in parent.restricted:
+                agg = f"SELECT a.* FROM ({agg}) a SEMI JOIN {total} USING(k)"
+            part = small.marginals[b] = self.table(agg)
+            large.marginals[b] = self.table(
+                f"SELECT k,t.s-coalesce(p.s,0) AS s,t.n-coalesce(p.n,0) AS n "
+                f"FROM {total} t LEFT JOIN {part} p USING(k) WHERE t.n>coalesce(p.n,0)"
+            )
+
+    def root_message(self, branch):
+        key = self.keys[branch]
+        g_col, h_col = self.root.semi_ring.get_columns_name()
+        if branch not in self.base_marginals:
+            self.base_marginals[branch] = self.table(
+                f"SELECT {key} AS k,sum({g_col}) AS s,sum({h_col})::BIGINT AS n "
+                f"FROM {self.base} GROUP BY {key}", temporary=False
+            )
+        source = self.base_marginals[branch]
+        other = next((b for b in self.offsets if b != branch), None)
+        if other is not None:
+            if branch not in self.projected:
+                adjustment = self.offsets[other]
+                change = (
+                    f"SELECT t.{key} AS k,sum(d.delta) AS adj FROM {self.base} t "
+                    f"JOIN {adjustment} d ON d.k=t.{self.keys[other]} GROUP BY t.{key}"
+                )
+                self.projected[branch] = self.table(
+                    f"SELECT k,s-adj AS s,n FROM {source} m JOIN ({change}) c USING(k)",
+                    temporary=False
+                )
+            source = self.projected[branch]
+        if branch in self.offsets:
+            offset = self.offsets[branch]
+            return f"(SELECT k,s-delta*n AS s,n,delta AS shift FROM {source} JOIN {offset} USING(k))"
+        return f"(SELECT *,0::DOUBLE AS shift FROM {source})"
+
+    def score_histogram(self, message, mapping, totals):
+        values = ", ".join(f"({i},{g!r}::DOUBLE,{h}::BIGINT)" for i,(g,h) in totals.items())
+        source = (f"(SELECT nid,s,n,unnest(bins) AS bin FROM {message})" if mapping is None else
+                  f"{message} m JOIN {mapping} USING(k)")
+        rows = self.exe._execute_query(
+            f"WITH hist AS (SELECT nid,bin,sum(s) AS s,sum(n)::BIGINT AS n "
+            f"FROM {source} GROUP BY nid,bin), prefix AS (SELECT nid,f,v,bin,"
+            f"sum(s) OVER w AS gs,sum(n) OVER w AS hs FROM hist JOIN {self.bins} USING(bin) "
+            f"WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY nid,f ORDER BY bin)) "
+            f"SELECT DISTINCT ON (nid) nid,f,v,bin,gs,hs,gs/hs*gs+(g-gs)/(h-hs)*(g-gs) AS gain "
+            f"FROM prefix JOIN (VALUES {values}) t(nid,g,h) USING(nid) WHERE hs<h "
+            f"ORDER BY nid,gain DESC,f,bin"
+        )
+        return {nid: row for nid,*row in rows}
+
+    def route_keys(self, source, proposals):
+        rules = [f"WHEN {nid} THEN bins[{self.slots[f]}]>{cut}" for nid,(f,_,cut,*_) in proposals.items()]
+        # An unsplittable group can be carried intact through later levels.
+        side = f"CASE nid {' '.join(rules)} ELSE false END" if rules else "false"
+        return self.table(
+            f"SELECT p.* REPLACE ((2*nid+({side})::INT) AS nid) FROM {source} p"
+        )
+
+    def prepare_coarse(self, primary, secondary):
+        # Each interval groups adjacent feature values, keeping frequent
+        # values separate. The cells are exact messages at the grain of the
+        # primary foreign key and the interval of a secondary feature.
+        mapping = self.bin_maps[secondary]
+        bin_ids = self.table(
+            f"WITH freq AS (SELECT f,bin,count(*) n FROM {mapping} JOIN {self.bins} USING(bin) "
+            f"GROUP BY f,bin), ranks AS (SELECT *,sum(n) OVER (PARTITION BY f ORDER BY bin)-n AS pos,"
+            f"sum(n) OVER (PARTITION BY f) AS total FROM freq), buckets AS (SELECT f,bin,"
+            f"CASE WHEN n*10>total THEN -bin ELSE floor(10*2/pi()*asin(sqrt((pos+0.5*n)/total))) "
+            f"END AS bucket,sum((n*10>total)::INT) OVER (PARTITION BY f ORDER BY bin) AS section "
+            f"FROM ranks) SELECT f,bin,min(bin) OVER w AS lo,max(bin) OVER w AS hi "
+            f"FROM buckets WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY f,section,bucket)"
+        )
+        self.coarse_bins = self.table(f"SELECT DISTINCT f,lo,hi FROM {bin_ids}",temporary=False)
+        g_col, h_col = self.root.semi_ring.get_columns_name()
+        self.coarse_cells = self.table(
+            f"SELECT t.{self.keys[primary]} AS k,lo,sum(t.{h_col})::BIGINT AS n,"
+            f"sum(t.{g_col}) AS s,sum(t.{g_col}*t.{g_col}) AS q FROM {self.base} t "
+            f"JOIN (SELECT k,lo FROM {mapping} JOIN {bin_ids} USING(bin)) d "
+            f"ON d.k=t.{self.keys[secondary]} GROUP BY t.{self.keys[primary]},lo", temporary=False
+        )
+        self.coarse_primary = primary
+
+    def coarse_bounds(self, route, totals, depth):
+        values = ", ".join(f"({i},{g!r}::DOUBLE,{h}::BIGINT)" for i,(g,h) in totals.items())
+        pieces = ["SELECT * FROM fine"]
+        for level in range(1,depth+1):
+            pieces.append(
+                f"SELECT nid >> {level} AS parent,lo,sum(n)::BIGINT AS n,sum(s) AS s,sum(q) AS q "
+                f"FROM fine GROUP BY parent,lo"
+            )
+        return dict(self.exe._execute_query(
+            f"WITH fine AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT nid,lo,sum(c.n)::BIGINT AS n,"
+            f"sum(c.s-c.n*r.shift) AS s,sum(c.q-r.shift*(2*c.s-c.n*r.shift)) AS q "
+            f"FROM {route} r JOIN {self.coarse_cells} c USING(k) GROUP BY nid,lo), "
+            f"cells AS ({' UNION ALL '.join(pieces)}), totals(nid,g,h) AS (VALUES {values}), "
+            f"centered AS (SELECT *, s-n*g/h AS sc,greatest(0,q-g/h*(2*s-n*g/h)) AS qc "
+            f"FROM cells JOIN {self.coarse_bins} USING(lo) JOIN totals USING(nid)), prefix AS ("
+            f"SELECT *,sum(sc) OVER w AS gr,sum(n) OVER w AS nr FROM centered "
+            f"WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY nid,f ORDER BY lo)), limits AS (SELECT nid,"
+            f"CASE WHEN lo=hi THEN coalesce(gr*gr/nullif(nr*(1-nr/h),0),0) ELSE least("
+            f"coalesce(pow(gr-sc,2)/nullif(nr-n,0),0)+coalesce(gr*gr/nullif(h-nr,0),0)+qc,"
+            f"pow(abs(gr-0.5*sc)+0.5*sqrt(n*qc),2)/nullif(least((nr-n)*(1-(nr-n)/h),nr*(1-nr/h)),0)) "
+            f"END AS cap FROM prefix) SELECT nid,max(cap) FROM limits GROUP BY nid"
+        ))
+
+    def candidate_messages(self):
+        """Batch the histograms for promising partitions of one dimension branch.
+
+        Routing uses that branch's marginal only. A single fact aggregation
+        then supplies the other branch's messages for every proposed region.
+        The tree builder compares both branches at each visited node. A split
+        outside the proposed regions switches its children to lazy messages.
+        """
+        root = self.root
+        first = self.primary
+        second = next(b for b in self.bin_maps if b != first)
+        totals = {1: root.semi_ring.get_value()}
+        route = (f"(SELECT m.*,b.bins,1 AS nid FROM {self.root_message(first)} m "
+                 f"JOIN {self.lookup[first]} b USING(k))")
+        all_totals = {}
+        self.routes = []
+        self.proposals = {}
+        for level in range(self.lookahead_depth):
+            all_totals.update(totals)
+            self.routes.append(route)
+            candidates = self.score_histogram(route, None, totals)
+            self.proposals.update(candidates)
+            if level+1 == self.lookahead_depth or not candidates:
+                break
+            child_totals = {}
+            for nid,(f,val,cut,gs,hs,criterion) in candidates.items():
+                g,h = totals[nid]
+                child_totals[2*nid] = (gs,hs)
+                child_totals[2*nid+1] = (g-gs,h-hs)
+            route = self.route_keys(route, candidates)
+            totals = child_totals
+
+        self.candidates = dict(self.proposals)
+        last_level = len(self.routes)-1
+        # Building the interval messages expands one copy per secondary feature.
+        # Amortize that grouping over repeated multi-level fact aggregations.
+        secondary_features = sum(self.feature_branch[a.table()] == second for a in self.features)
+        if (self.coarse_primary is None and self.rounds >= 3 * secondary_features
+                and 1 < self.lookahead_depth == self.max_depth):
+            self.prepare_coarse(first,second)
+        required = set(all_totals)
+        if self.coarse_cells and self.coarse_primary == first and second not in self.offsets:
+            caps = self.coarse_bounds(route,all_totals,last_level)
+            required = {
+                nid for nid in all_totals if nid not in self.proposals or
+                self.proposals[nid][-1] - all_totals[nid][0]**2/all_totals[nid][1]
+                <= caps.get(nid,0)*(1+1e-8) + 1e-5
+            }
+            if not required:
+                self.other_messages = None
+                return
+        if last_level == 0:
+            root_choice = self.proposals.get(1)
+            if (self.max_depth == 1 and root_choice and
+                    root_choice[-1] > self.norm_bound[second]**2 * (1+1e-10)+1e-6):
+                self.other_messages = None
+                return
+            self.other_messages = f"(SELECT *,1 AS nid FROM {self.root_message(second)})"
+        else:
+            g_col, h_col = root.semi_ring.get_columns_name()
+            shift = ""
+            joins = ""
+            if second in self.offsets:
+                shift = " - d.delta"
+                joins = f"JOIN {self.offsets[second]} d ON t.{self.keys[second]}=d.k"
+            chosen = route
+            if len(required) != len(all_totals):
+                conditions = []
+                for nid in sorted(required):
+                    distance = last_level+1-nid.bit_length()
+                    conditions.append(f"(nid >> {distance})={nid}")
+                chosen = f"(SELECT * FROM {route} WHERE {' OR '.join(conditions)})"
+            finest = self.table(
+                f"SELECT t.{self.keys[second]} AS k,r.nid,sum(t.{g_col}-r.shift{shift}) AS s,"
+                f"sum(t.{h_col})::BIGINT AS n FROM {self.base} t "
+                f"JOIN {chosen} r ON t.{self.keys[first]}=r.k {joins} GROUP BY r.nid,t.{self.keys[second]}"
+            )
+            rollups = [f"SELECT * FROM {finest}"]
+            for distance in range(1,last_level+1):
+                rollups.append(
+                    f"SELECT k,nid >> {distance} AS parent,sum(s) AS s,sum(n)::BIGINT AS n "
+                    f"FROM {finest} GROUP BY k,parent"
+                )
+            self.other_messages = self.table(" UNION ALL ".join(rollups))
+
+        # A split that groups keys cannot have greater uncentered explained
+        # sum of squares than assigning a separate mean to every key.
+        bounds = self.exe._execute_query(
+            f"SELECT nid,sum(s*s/n) FROM {self.other_messages} GROUP BY nid"
+        )
+        refine = {}
+        for nid, bound in bounds:
+            if nid not in required:
+                continue
+            if nid == 1:
+                self.norm_bound[second] = math.sqrt(max(bound,0))
+            candidate = self.proposals.get(nid)
+            if nid in all_totals and (not candidate or candidate[-1] <= bound*(1+1e-10)+1e-6):
+                refine[nid] = all_totals[nid]
+        if refine:
+            ids = ','.join(map(str,refine))
+            message = f"(SELECT * FROM {self.other_messages} t WHERE nid IN ({ids}))"
+            exact = self.score_histogram(message, self.bin_maps[second], refine)
+            for nid,row in exact.items():
+                old = self.proposals.get(nid)
+                if old is None or (row[-1],-row[0]) > (old[-1],-old[0]):
+                    self.candidates[nid] = row
+
+    def best_split(self, node, node_id, depth):
+        g, h = node.semi_ring.get_value()
+        if len(self.bin_maps) == 2 and node.on_plan and depth < len(self.routes):
+            first = self.primary
+            second = next(b for b in self.bin_maps if b != first)
+            node.marginals = {
+                first: f"(SELECT k,s,n FROM {self.routes[depth]} t WHERE nid={node.heap_id})"
+            }
+            if self.other_messages:
+                node.marginals[second] = f"(SELECT k,s,n FROM {self.other_messages} t WHERE nid={node.heap_id})"
+            node.restricted = {first} if depth else set()
+            row = self.candidates.get(node.heap_id)
+            if row is None:
+                return (0,depth,"","",0,0,0,node_id)
+            if not depth:
+                self.next_primary = self.feature_branch[self.features[row[0]].table()]
+            return self.split_tuple(node,node_id,depth,row)
+        if node.split_parent is not None and node.marginals is None:
+            self.split_messages(node)
+        parts = [
+            f"SELECT bin,sum(s) AS s,sum(n)::BIGINT AS n FROM {message} "
+            f"JOIN {self.bin_maps[branch]} USING(k) GROUP BY bin"
+            for branch, message in node.marginals.items()
+        ]
+        stats = " UNION ALL ".join(parts)
+        rows = self.exe._execute_query(
+            f"WITH hist AS ({stats}), prefix AS ("
+            f"SELECT f,v,bin,sum(s) OVER w AS gs,sum(n) OVER w AS hs FROM hist "
+            f"JOIN {self.bins} USING(bin) WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY f ORDER BY bin)) "
+            f"SELECT f,v,bin,gs,hs,gs/hs*gs + ({g!r}-gs)/({h}-hs)*({g!r}-gs) AS gain "
+            f"FROM prefix WHERE hs<{h} ORDER BY gain DESC,f,bin LIMIT 1"
+        )
+        if not rows:
+            return (0, depth, "", "", 0, 0, 0, node_id)
+        return self.split_tuple(node, node_id, depth, rows[0])
+
+    def split_tuple(self, node, node_id, depth, row):
+        g, h = node.semi_ring.get_value()
+        f, value, split_bin, left_g, left_h, criterion = row
+        attr = self.features[f]
+        node.split_bin = (f, split_bin)
+        return (float(g*g/h)-criterion, depth, attr.table(), attr, str(value), left_g, left_h, node_id)
+
+    def clear_messages(self):
+        if self.temporary:
+            self.exe._execute_query(";".join(f"DROP TABLE {t}" for t in self.temporary))
+            self.temporary = []
+
+    def target_view(self, root):
+        joins = []
+        terms = [f"t.{root.semi_ring.gradient_column_name}"]
+        for i,(dim,table) in enumerate(self.offsets.items()):
+            joins.append(f"JOIN {table} d{i} ON d{i}.k=t.{self.keys[dim]}")
+            terms.append(f"d{i}.delta")
+        name = self.exe.get_next_name()
+        self.exe._execute_query(
+            f"CREATE VIEW {name} AS SELECT t.* REPLACE (({' - '.join(terms)}) "
+            f"AS {root.semi_ring.gradient_column_name}) FROM {self.base} t {' '.join(joins)}"
+        )
+        return name
+
+    def advance(self, root, leaves, rate):
+        target = root.target_relation
+        g_col, _ = root.semi_ring.get_columns_name()
+        rules = []
+        branches = set()
+        energy = 0.0
+        for leaf in leaves:
+            g,h = leaf.semi_ring.get_value()
+            preds = {}
+            for f,cut,op in leaf.bin_path:
+                branch = self.feature_branch[self.features[f].table()]
+                preds.setdefault(branch,[]).append(f"bins[{self.slots[f]}]{op}{cut}")
+                branches.add(branch)
+            rules.append((float(g / h) * rate, preds))
+            energy += g*g/h
+        if not branches:
+            return
+        if len(branches) == 1:
+            branch = next(iter(branches))
+            table = self.lookup[branch]
+            arms = [f"WHEN {' AND '.join(p[branch])} THEN {value!r}::DOUBLE" for value,p in rules]
+            prediction = f"CASE {' '.join(arms)} ELSE 0 END"
+            previous = branch in self.offsets
+            base = "delta+" if previous else ""
+            self.exe._execute_query(
+                f"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE {table} AS SELECT * REPLACE "
+                f"(({base}{prediction}) AS delta) FROM {table}"
+            )
+            self.offsets[branch] = table
+            if not previous:
+                root.replace(target,self.target_view(root))
+                if target != self.base:
+                    self.exe._execute_query(f"DROP VIEW {target}")
+            step_norm = rate * math.sqrt(energy)
+            for b in self.norm_bound:
+                if b != branch:
+                    self.norm_bound[b] += step_norm
+                    if b in self.projected:
+                        self.exe.delete_table(self.projected.pop(b))
+        else:
+            joins = []
+            terms = [f"t.{g_col}"]
+            masks = []
+            arms = []
+            aliases = {}
+            for i,branch in enumerate(sorted(branches | self.offsets.keys())):
+                alias = aliases[branch] = f"d{i}"
+                projection = ["k"]
+                if branch in self.offsets:
+                    projection.append("delta")
+                    terms.append(f"{alias}.delta")
+                if branch in branches:
+                    if len(rules) <= 63:
+                        bits = []
+                        for j,(_,preds) in enumerate(rules):
+                            cond = ' AND '.join(preds.get(branch,[])) or 'true'
+                            bits.append(f"CASE WHEN {cond} THEN {1<<j} ELSE 0 END")
+                        projection.append(f"({' | '.join(bits)}) AS mask")
+                        masks.append(f"{alias}.mask")
+                    else:
+                        projection.append("bins")
+                joins.append(f"JOIN (SELECT {','.join(projection)} FROM {self.lookup[branch]}) "
+                             f"{alias} ON {alias}.k=t.{self.keys[branch]}")
+            if masks:
+                switch = " & ".join(masks)
+                arms = [f"WHEN {1<<j} THEN {value!r}::DOUBLE" for j,(value,_) in enumerate(rules)]
+            else:
+                switch = ""
+                for value,preds in rules:
+                    cond = ' AND '.join(f"{aliases[b]}.{term}" for b,items in preds.items() for term in items)
+                    arms.append(f"WHEN {cond} THEN {value!r}::DOUBLE")
+            terms.append(f"(CASE {switch} {' '.join(arms)} ELSE 0 END)")
+            updated = self.table(
+                f"SELECT t.* REPLACE (({' - '.join(terms)}) AS {g_col}) "
+                f"FROM {self.base} t {' '.join(joins)}", temporary=False
+            )
+            root.replace(target,updated)
+            if target != self.base:
+                self.exe._execute_query(f"DROP VIEW {target}")
+            if self.base_view:
+                self.exe._execute_query(f"DROP VIEW {self.base}")
+            else:
+                self.exe.delete_table(self.base)
+            for table in [*self.base_marginals.values(),*self.projected.values()]:
+                self.exe.delete_table(table)
+            self.projected = {}
+            self.norm_bound = dict.fromkeys(self.bin_maps, float("inf"))
+            if self.coarse_cells:
+                self.exe.delete_table(self.coarse_cells)
+                self.exe.delete_table(self.coarse_bins)
+                self.coarse_cells = None
+            self.base = updated
+            self.base_view = False
+            self.offsets = {}
+            self.base_marginals = {}
+        if len(self.bin_maps) == 2:
+            self.primary = getattr(self, "next_primary", self.primary)
